description: This file defines the GraphicsUnit class in the PdfSharp.Features.Drawing namespace, related to rendering graphics in PDF, specifically handling different page directions (downwards and upwards).

classes.name: GraphicsUnit
classes.description: A class representing a graphics unit for drawing operations, with methods to render graphics in different directions.

methods.name: Downwards
methods.description: Renders a graphics snippet with page direction downwards.

methods.name: Upwards
methods.description: Renders a graphics snippet with page direction upwards.
